title: `_packPoolVirtualBalance()` reverts due to incorrect `POOL_VB_MASK`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  All calculations with POOL_VB_MASK always revert due to a wrong value stored. E.g. reverts in `_packPoolVirtualBalance()` during the liquidity provision.  ## Recommendations  `POOL_VB_MASK` value should be fixed:  ```diff - uint256 public constant POOL_VB_MASK = 2 * 128 - 1; + uint256 public constant POOL_VB_MASK = 2 ** 128 - 1; ```
